title: Add Graceful Shutdown & Health‑Check Endpoints
description: Introduce a built‑in graceful shutdown routine that stops accepting new connections, finishes in‑flight requests, and closes resources, plus a `/healthz` endpoint for liveness/readiness checks. This improves reliability in container orchestration and reduces abrupt terminations.
testCases: Verify that the server stops accepting new connections after SIGTERM and resolves pending requests before exiting
Ensure GET /healthz returns 200 with JSON {status:'ok'} and proper content‑type
acceptance: When a SIGTERM (or SIGINT) is sent, the server stops accepting new requests, waits up to 10 seconds for ongoing requests to finish, then exits with code 0. The `/healthz` endpoint must be reachable at any time and return a 200 JSON payload indicating service health.
reason: Containers and orchestrators (K8s, ECS) rely on graceful termination and health checks to manage scaling and restarts. Adding this feature eliminates the need for custom shutdown logic, reduces downtime, and aligns yantraverse with production‑grade expectations.
